purpose: Deterministic, pre-registered admission record for one Qwen3 Layer-0 routed-expert candidate, or no_candidate_admitted.
invariants: Numerical gates are registered before final_validation is executed.
An admitted candidate has byte-identical reconversion, deterministic repeated execution, exact structural checks, and direct-consumption proof.
An admitted candidate's observed logit envelope is no greater than the pre-registered cap and one quarter of every relevant frozen held-out top-1 margin.
no_candidate_admitted is valid only when no candidate is marked admitted.
